i.norm:
Verifies that {@link SequencesComparator#getScript()} reports the expected number of edit modifications (deletions + insertions) needed to transform a "before" string into an "after" string.

Each {@link DiffCase} pairs the two strings with the modification count that the Myers diff algorithm is expected to produce, so the relationship between an input pair and its expected result is visible at a glance.
A single comparison scenario: transform {@code before} into {@code after} and expect exactly {@code expectedModifications} edit commands.
The scenarios under test, mirroring the original parallel-array fixtures.
Converts a string into a list of its characters, the input form expected by {@link SequencesComparator}.
